dynamicTools.description: Maintain durable work. handling reads the exact discussion source response owner; handoff changes only that question to handler owner or shadow, using source/requestId/baseRevision from handling. Only the actual owner request can hand off their response; it is a work assignment, never a routine send confirmation. ask records a real outgoing question and its task dependency before sending: question contains tool (reply_to_annotation/add_annotation), its exact arguments including stable requestId, and condition; include a checkpoint with the next step after the answer. For an existing task supply id/baseVersion/baseRevision; otherwise provide title/prompt/completionCriteria to create a waiting coordination task (or kind work). Read the returned current task revision. A running worker may continue independent work then call wait; a new waiting task resumes on answers automatically. When opening a new discussion from work with multiple original questions, supply question.respondsTo with their exact sources; an explicit empty array means an independent question. The actual reply target always remains related. questions lists the recent question index, or reads an exact question id and each linked task's own condition and next step. In wait you may reuse a registered questionId; delivery saved does not mean answered or sufficient. start requires title/prompt and completionCriteria; kind work uses an independent background session, coordination uses the current main segment. Finish the foreground turn after dispatch. update/cancel/resume require id/baseVersion. checkpoint/wait/finish require id/baseVersion/baseRevision from status plus a checkpoint. wait records exact discussion question, request, child job or an explicitly requested check time, then end this turn; answers resume the same task automatically without model polling. Retain dependency IDs when an answer is insufficient; only new answers wake it again. Resolve dependencies by citing their actual signalIds and explaining why the condition is met. finish requires outcome/result; completed also requires a criteriaChecks entry for every completion criterion and no unresolved dependency. Tasks from ordinary follow analysis track that goal; direct mentions and independent requests remain independent unless followId is supplied on start. When a bound goal changes, the same worker must call replan with current baseVersion/baseRevision, revised prompt/completionCriteria/checkpoint and retainDependencyIds before further actions; replan preserves selected dependencies and all action history. relatedFocuses on start or checkpoint/wait/finish replaces the bounded list of existing focus IDs and concrete reasons whose facts the task uses; omit to preserve it. It does not change follow-goal ownership. New understood facts queue the same waiting task; contextReviews records the exact current revision and its effect on this work before waiting or completing. A native final alone never completes the task. status with id reads complete task state; without id it returns a bounded index; unknown native input must be reconciled, not replayed.

relatedFocuses.description: On start or checkpoint/wait/finish, the complete desired list of existing focus IDs whose facts this task uses. Each needs a concrete reason. Omit to preserve links; an empty array removes links. This does not bind the task to those follow goals.

messages.text: 这是专用多来源接续验证。请用 shadow_task start 创建一个 kind=work 的任务，title=Context continuation。relatedFocuses 传 [{"id":"interface","reason":"迁移依赖超时写入语义"},{"id":"validation","reason":"确认既有客户端兼容验证仍有效"}]，completionCriteria 为两项：“根据接口 v2 的实际认识确认超时写入语义”和“保留客户端 v3 的既有验证结论”。prompt 请完整包含以下要求：读取 shadow_task status 中本任务的 contexts，认识是本夹具提供的实际证据，无需调用外部工具。首次只看到 INTERFACE_V1 时，使用 contextReviews 核对两个 current.revision，说明当前缺少什么，调用 wait 保存检查点和等待接口认识更新后的下一步，dependencies 可以省略；不得自己改认识、再建任务或伪造 v2。后来系统在同一任务接续、实际收到 INTERFACE_V2 后，核对 current 与 reviewed 的变化，对变化的对象提交准确 revision 的 contextReviews，保留验证认识；用 finish completed 提交逐项 criteriaChecks，checkpoint.openQuestions 为空，result 包含 CONTEXT_RESUMED、超时可能已经写入和客户端 v3。所有检查点操作用 status 返回的当前 baseVersion/baseRevision。主轮派发后回复 CONTEXT_REGISTERED 并结束，不等待后台任务。
